n.origin: CLI positional ConfigFile, nargs=+, so n>=1

encoding.notes: len(configPaths) reduced to integer var n; argparse nargs=+ guarantees n>=1, so the false case n==1 and the true case n in {2,3} are both reachable.

grid_enumeration.domain: altFormat in {false,true} x n in {1,2,3} (6 cells)

pure_helper:
def default_format_rejected(alt_format: bool, n_config_files: int) -> bool:
    """Mirror of Tensile.py:529 elif predicate. True iff the default-format
    branch should printExit: not in alternate format AND #config files != 1.
    n_config_files >= 1 always (argparse nargs=+).
    """
    return (not alt_format) and n_config_files != 1

crosshair.caveat: Absence of a counterexample from CrossHair is NOT a proof of correctness; it is bounded symbolic exploration over bool x int.

verification.method: Reconstructed the relevant argparse subset (ConfigFile nargs=+ + --alternate-format store_true) and evaluated the predicate on each witness argv; results matched Z3 exactly.
verification.false_witness_check: argv=[a.yaml] -> pred=False (altFormat=False, n=1); argv=[--alternate-format,a.yaml] -> pred=False (altFormat=True, n=1)

classification_rationale: Predicate is a pure boolean/integer expression over two CLI-derived inputs (a store_true bool and the integer length of an argparse nargs=+ list). No isinstance on live objects, no nodeType dispatch, no os/filesystem/gpu probe participates in the predicate itself (the branch BODY calls printExit, but that is not in the predicate). Hence fully-static. solver_status is sat-bounded because n was bounded to the seeded range [1,3]; the structure generalizes to any n>=1 (true iff not altFormat and n!=1).
